KAGETORALANCER-JEWELED_PAGODA_OF_BISHAMO: #Whenever you complete a Doctrine cycle, draw 1 card.
A small pagoda rings once when all three precepts fall into place.
KAGETORALANCER-GREAT_PAGODA_OF_BISHAMONT: #Replaces the Jeweled Pagoda. Whenever you complete a Doctrine cycle, draw 2 cards.
The whole formation turns beneath the gaze of the god of war.
KAGETORALANCER-OATH_OF_ECHIGO.title: Oath of Echigo
KAGETORALANCER-OATH_OF_ECHIGO.descriptio: #Earn Bond from rooms and victories. Bond grants Max HP; at level 4 start with 10 Critical Stars, at 7 also 20 NP Charge, and at 10 also Bishamonten's Blessing.
KAGETORALANCER-OATH_OF_ECHIGO.flavor: Mercy for the people, salt for a rival, and no retreat from a just battle.
KAGETORALANCER-RECORD_OF_EIGHT_FORMATION: #At card rewards you may give up the card to roll for an NP duplicate. A duplicate raises NP level; failed rolls build pity and grant consolation.
Eight paths are written in the margins. Every defeat closes one.
KAGETORALANCER-COMMANDERS_HOLY_GRAIL.des: #Gain !MaxHp! Max HP. Bond can reach level 12 and NP level can reach 6.
KAGETORALANCER-COMMANDERS_HOLY_GRAIL.fla: A vessel that promises no miracle—only a larger battlefield on which to earn one.
KAGETORALANCER-SAKE_CUP.title: Sake Cup
KAGETORALANCER-SAKE_CUP.description: #At the start of your first turn, draw 1 card, then discard 1.
KAGETORALANCER-SAKE_CUP.flavor: A clear cup held steady while bullets pass on either side.
KAGETORALANCER-EIGHT_PETAL_BANNER.title: Eight-Petal Banner
KAGETORALANCER-EIGHT_PETAL_BANNER.descri: #The first successful Doctrine advance each turn grants 2 Block.
KAGETORALANCER-EIGHT_PETAL_BANNER.flavor: Eight white petals open above a line that refuses to bend.
KAGETORALANCER-HOUSHOUTSUKIGE_REINS.desc: #The first Feet card each turn grants 10 Critical Stars after resolving.
KAGETORALANCER-HOUSHOUTSUKIGE_REINS.flav: The white horse needs neither spur nor command—only a direction.
KAGETORALANCER-SIX_PLATE_ARMOUR.title: Six-Plate Armour
KAGETORALANCER-SIX_PLATE_ARMOUR.descript: #The first Chest card each turn grants 4 additional Block after resolving.
KAGETORALANCER-SIX_PLATE_ARMOUR.flavor: Six plates overlap where a commander's heart is expected to be.
KAGETORALANCER-SHIRANUI_TACHI.title: Shiranui Tachi
KAGETORALANCER-SHIRANUI_TACHI.descriptio: #The first Critical each turn grants 10 NP Charge.
KAGETORALANCER-SHIRANUI_TACHI.flavor: The white flame follows its edge without warmth or smoke.
KAGETORALANCER-WHITE_FLAME_BRAZIER.title: White Flame Brazier
KAGETORALANCER-WHITE_FLAME_BRAZIER.descr: #When you ascend to Kenshin, once per combat gain 1 Energy and 30 Critical Stars.
KAGETORALANCER-WHITE_FLAME_BRAZIER.flavo: The flame waits without flickering until the second name is spoken.
KAGETORALANCER-ECHIGO_SALT_BAG.title: Echigo Salt Bag
KAGETORALANCER-ECHIGO_SALT_BAG.descripti: #At combat start, every player gains 1 Artifact. Gain 10 NP Charge for each ally.
KAGETORALANCER-ECHIGO_SALT_BAG.flavor: Victory over a starving rival would prove nothing. Send the salt.
